base: LR-time plus 3 fixed A1 features; independent of LR-content

definitions.a1_remarks_characters: Whitespace-normalized full REM character count; includes any residual headers, not a measure of argument quality.
definitions.a1_claim_change_present: Reviewed claim markup has ins/del tags or Currently Amended/Amended/New status.
definitions.a1_canceled_status_present: Reviewed A1 listing includes numbered claim/range Canceled/Cancelled status; does not prove a newly canceled claim relative to O1.

missing_handling: Blank, imputed with training median only; never interpreted as verified absence.
limitations: Exploratory experiment proposed after viewing earlier test results.
Reply content enters through coarse proxies, not semantic modeling of claim responses.
No examiner effect feature or causal control; historical examiner metadata audit remains separate.
Evaluation excludes pending outcomes, not a censoring-aware survival model.
No feature changes or tuning after new test metrics.
